description: Frontier trading culture of free carriers, water thieves, and off-ledger spice runners.
name: spice smuggler
notes: Starter biography pool is configured for the named owned PawnKinds by Patches/Patch_SoABackstoryPools.xml; existing saved pawn histories are untouched.

starterStories.body: The current source configuration assigns the Spice smuggler starter pool to SoA_SpiceSmuggler. Its childhood stories are workhouse survivor (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_IndustrialOrphan13), abandoned outpost child (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_AbandonedChild23), and caravan adoptee (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_CrashBaby32); adult stories are covert workshop builder (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_IllegalShipwright76), contraband escort (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_SpacePirate55), and freight broker (SoA_Bio_Smuggler_CorporateManager76). The 18 authored stories retain their selected Core template mechanics; this pool changes which stories newly generated owned pawns may draw from, not their skill rules. The category patch does not migrate biographies already stored in saves. This is a bounded starter pool, not a claim that every pawn of this culture uses these stories.
